parsed.basis: Straseni is a small central Moldovan district town near Chisinau, with a rural, socially conservative profile and no documented local protective institutions, LGBT services, or separate transgender-related law distinct from the national regime. Moldova has no criminalisation of transition or same-sex conduct, and since 2022-2023 hate speech, hate crimes and discrimination on gender identity grounds are formally prohibited, yet enforcement is weak, discrimination and hate speech remain commonplace, and public acceptance is very low. A visitor recognised as transgender would therefore be most exposed to service refusal, harassment and hostile local attitudes, with formal recourse likely to depend on institutions concentrated in Chisinau and police response historically inconsistent, including documented failures to investigate attacks and abusive treatment of a transgender detainee in custody in 2025.
